headline: Cyclone Akvan Crosses Near Gopalpur
deck: Odisha Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said no major damage or loss of life had been reported in the state so far.
body: Cyclonic Storm Akvan crossed the North Andhra Pradesh–South Odisha coast close to Gopalpur, and the India Meteorological Department said the landfall process would continue for two hours. [E3]
The system lay centred over south coastal Odisha and adjoining north coastal Andhra Pradesh, the India Meteorological Department said. [E1]
At landfall, Akvan had sustained winds of 70–80 kmph, with gusts reaching 90 kmph. [E2]
Odisha Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said no major damage or loss of life had been reported in the state so far. [E4]
